messages:
mira.k: Heads-up — kicking off bring-up for equinox-11b-lite (candidate for int8/4 quant). Goal: get a baseline perf matrix (throughput, p50/p95 latency), ctx sweep (512, 2048, 8192), and quick quality smoke vs. prod-13b prompts. TL;DR: need owners for perf runs, quant smoke, and evals.

danielle: I can own the quant smoke runs tomorrow morning. plan to run int8 + int4 per-layer and compare logits/likelihood drift.

alex_r: I’ll do batching/throughput profiles on Dedicated sim. Want to test batch sizes [1,4,8,16,32] and 3 concurrency levels. will push a small harness to infra.

sachin: I’ll lead quality evals. can we pin the eval set to the current prod-13b canonical promptset v3? also want a short human review on 50 samples.

mira.k: Perfect. Checklist I propose (quick):
1) Model build: convert to hf format and upload artifact to gcs (name: eqx-11b-lite-v0.1).
2) Baseline inference: run single-GPU p50/p95 latency for seq=512, bs=1.
3) Batching sweep: bs=[1,4,8,16,32], ctx=[512,2048,8192], concurrency=[1,4,8] — record tokens/sec.
4) Quant smoke: int8 + int4-per-layer, compare perplexity and generation divergence metrics.
5) Quality eval: run automated eval (ROUGE/BLEU/LL diff) + 50 human checks.
6) Safety/regression quick-check: run safety prompts from safety-suite v2.
7) Report: small README with key perf numbers + recommended quant config.

mira.k: Also: target is to get actionable recommendation for prod rollout (no rollout yet) — aim for a decision by EOD +2 days.

danielle: For quant runs I’ll use the new quant harness: `scripts/quant_smoke.py --model eqx-11b-lite --modes int8 int4-perlayer --save outputs/quant_smoke/`. Will log to bench-bot. any special flags?

alex_r: infra notes: Dedicated sim nodes are tagged `sim-dedicated-small`. Batching harness is `tools/batch_profile.py`. Example command I’ll run:```bash
python tools/batch_profile.py --model gcs://redwood/models/eqx-11b-lite-v0.1 --ctx 2048 --batch-sizes 1,4,8,16,32 --concurrency 1,4,8 --out /tmp/eqx-batch.json
```
Results will be pushed to the bench dashboard: https://bench.redwood.internal/runs/eqx-11b-lite-{{run_id}}

bench-bot: New run created: eqx-11b-lite-batch-1765550042, status: queued.

sachin: For evals I’ll run `eval-runner --suite canonical-v3 --model eqx-11b-lite-v0.1 --out evals/eqx_v0.1.json` then sample 50 for human review. Assign human review to @mira.k and @danielle.

mira.k: Assigned, thanks.

danielle: Quick note on quality thresholds: fail if average log-likelihood delta > 0.15 vs prod-13b, or if BLEU drops > 5 points on summarization subset. Otherwise we accept for further optimization.

alex_r: One perf catch: int4 path might not support 8k ctx without spilling — I’ll flag any OOMs. If OOM occurs, we fallback to 2-stage context strategy and measure effective throughput.

mira.k: Risk matrix (short):
- Quant drift: moderate risk — mitigations: per-layer fallback and regen checks.
- Latency regressions at high ctx: moderate-high — mitigations: recommend quant+kv-cache warmup and reduce batch size.
- Quality regressions: low-moderate — mitigations: human check + eval suite.

bench-bot: eqx-11b-lite quant_smoke run 1765550100 completed. artifacts: gs://redwood-bench/eqx/quant_smoke_v0.1.tar.gz.

danielle: Uploaded initial quant logs. Int8 looks okay (LL delta ~0.03). int4-perlayer shows some tokens with reduced prob mass on long completions — sending sample diffs to `#eng-ml-files` (links: gs://redwood-bench/eqx/samples/int4_diffs.html).

sachin: Quick eval run done — automated metrics: ROUGE L down 2.1, avg LL delta 0.08 vs prod-13b. Human sample pass rate 42/50 (comments: minor hallucinations on long-context instructions). Will draft notes.

alex_r: Batch sweep results pushed: /tmp/eqx-batch-1765550200.json. High-level: bs=8, ctx=2048 gives best tokens/sec with acceptable p95 latency for Dedicated. 8k ctx throughput drops ~3x due to KV copy. attaching brief: gs://redwood-bench/eqx/perf_summary.pdf

mira.k: Preliminary verdict: int8 profile looks viable for further internal testing. int4 needs per-layer selective fallback; not ready for rollout. Action items:
- @danielle: write short RFC for recommended quant config (int8 default, int4-perlayer as experimental with per-layer fallbacks) — due +2 days.
- @alex_r: run a focused 8k ctx memory-stress test and try 2-stage context approach — due +1 day.
- @sachin: expand human review to 200 samples if possible and collect category tags on hallucinations — due +2 days.

mira.k: Thanks all. I’ll collect artifacts into a short README and ping biz if the metrics hold. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: CI Notice — perf/regression check queued for eqx-11b-lite. Job: ci/perf-eqx-1765550250
